summary.value: Hilton Club New York offers stylish Studios and spacious Suites with skyline views in a vacation-club stay in the heart of Midtown that guests describe as clean, comfortable and unusually quiet for the area. Most leave happy, but reviews flag missing room service, pricey breakfast and the occasional maintenance problem worth checking on arrival.

description.value: Run by Hilton Grand Vacations, Hilton Club New York offers stylish Studios and spacious Suites with skyline views, located in the heart of Midtown Manhattan, so Fifth Avenue, Rockefeller Center and Broadway are a walk away. Tripadvisor travelers give it 4.3 of 5 bubbles (940 reviews). Guest feedback is warm on rooms, which feel calm and well kept, and cooler on extras: there is no room service, breakfast costs more than many expect, and one stay started with an air-conditioning leak, so inspect the room early.

review1: Overall the Hilton Club gets warm verdicts, with guests saying that despite a few hiccups they enjoyed the stay and would consider returning to the property.
review2: Rooms are praised as clean, comfortable and about as quiet as Midtown allows, which matters to guests coming back after long days of sightseeing.
review3: Dining is a weaker point: there is no room service and guests found breakfast pricing much higher than they had expected from the advertised rate.
review4: Maintenance issues appear in the set, including an air-conditioning leak that forced a room change, so it is worth inspecting the room promptly after check-in.
